address: 42/99 Mu 9, Sukhumvit Road, Pattaya, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri, 20150, Thailand
bio: The go-to spot in Pattaya for pork offal soup with boiled sweet leaf bush, this eatery draws inspiration from Thai cuisine nationwide to offer a plethora of quick street food dishes. From the many noodle and rice options, the stir-fried glass noodles with seafood stand out....
